items.title: WARNING: India's Biggest AI Campus Faces Court Challenge Over Water and Power Impact
items.summary:
The Andhra Pradesh High Court is reviewing the Google Adani data center project in Vishakhapatam amid significant legal concerns.

This video examines the current status of the proposed $15 billion Google Adani data center. We break down the Andhra Pradesh government's recent assurances provided to the High Court, specifically addressing claims regarding environmental damage and regulatory compliance. If you are tracking major infrastructure developments in India, this summary clarifies the government's stance.

items.title: 🔴 LIVE: OpenAI Details Jalapeño Chip | AM Intelligence Orders 9,000 Rubin GPUs | Front Page
items.summary:
OpenAI revealed benchmark details for its first custom inference silicon, Jalapeño, delivering up to 1.9 times higher throughput per watt and up to 3.6 times lower end-to-end latency compared to Nvidia’s flagship Blackwell systems. In domestic AI infrastructure, Hyderabad-based AM Intelligence placed an order for 9,000 Nvidia Vera Rubin GPUs, committing $8 billion toward gigawatt-scale compute. Meanwhile, Apple launched its M6 Mac Mini powered by 2nm technology, Suzlon initiated ₹10,500 crore wind energy projects in AP, Airbound raised $37 million for a drone delivery network, and the AP High Court cleared the $15 billion Google-Adani data centre hub in Visakhapatnam.

items.title: What Is Architecting for Autonomy About? | Agentic AI in the Enterprise
items.summary:
What happens when AI moves beyond assisting people and starts acting with greater autonomy?

In this short, the author introduces Architecting for Autonomy and explains how the book helps organizations design agentic AI systems that are useful, trustworthy, and aligned with real business goals. It explores the architectural decisions behind autonomy, including governance, human oversight, risk, accountability, and where agents fit within the enterprise.

Learn more about Architecting for Autonomy, available now through Manning’s Early Access Program: https://hubs.la/Q04tZ_p50

#AgenticAI #EnterpriseAI #SoftwareArchitecture #AIAgents #ManningBooks
